decisions.reason: "That made" renders 합치면 and BASE keeps "of points" (막대한 포인트); SOL drops both without gaining naturalness.
Preserves the personified body parts crying out (외친다) and 발끝 "toes"; SOL turns it into the narrator's report and says "foot."

파공성 is an air-splitting sound; SOL's "roar" over-specifies and pre-empts the later 굉음 ("thunderous roar") in P29.
Korean is a full sentence (증거다); SOL's fragment loses it, and "match" suits 승부 better than "duel."
솟구치다 = shoot up; SOL's "surged" drops the upward motion from the waist.
Preserves 한발 "a step," 계산에 넣고 "factor in," and 다음 공격 "next attack," all dropped by SOL.
Keeps the terse noun fragment 묘한 기시감; SOL adds "came over me" not in the source.
Verbless nominal fragments (머리는 차갑게. 가슴은 뜨겁게.) match the sourceless mantra better than BASE's added imperatives.
"ruled over" and "ruled" are equally idiomatic; SOL offers no gain.

타고/향해 = "along...toward"; SOL's "through...into" adds arrival, and "blazed" for 눈부셨다 (dazzled) changes the sensory image.
Preserves the source's nominal list as punchy fragments, and singular "blast of wind" matches 풍압 better.
"without so much as a hairline crack" is idiomatic and keeps 실금 하나; "It" refers cleanly to the preceding spearhead.

Preserves 의문에 대한 "to my question."
